purpose: One original reference-only lily-pad study; no game integration.
method: Hand-authored native JS row silhouette and broad pixel clusters; no generative image tool.

contract.scale: One source pixel per logical pixel; no antialiasing.
contract.silhouette: Flattened oval leaf with one open right-hand wedge.
contract.views: Single static top/oblique reference view; eight-view set and rig attachment out of scope.
contract.detail: Notch only; no flower, texture, repeated primitive outlines or fine vein network.

references.userQuote: yes thats much better. use this look for the swamp, but make it a maze of connected islands with lots of shallow murky water and winding deep channels. keep everything editable and working with collision and cutting.
references.interpretation: Irregular banks, winding murky channels, distinct cypress/mangrove silhouettes, readable player scale. Approval of look; topology then requested as connected islands.

borrowed: Muted olive palette, broad flat clusters, restrained silhouette from retained approved swamp image. Earlier lily-pad praise is evidence of preference, not approval of this new sprite.
limitations: New draft has no user aesthetic approval.
No runtime, lighting, water-scale, rig, animation or Electron integration verification.
scope: Only this lily-pad-test directory is written. No gameplay, authored rigs, saves, builds, commit or push.

observations: One connected stepped leaf silhouette and broad flat clusters.
Narrowed the initial overlarge bite to a shallow right-hand wedge.
Four restrained olive greens; no texture, dithering or interior primitive outlines.
visualReview.acceptance: Technical validity and self-review do not confer user aesthetic approval.

originalReview.note: Right-hand Lily pad panel shows native and enlarged flowering pad.

priorAssetCorrection: Existing forest and swamp lily artwork predates this standalone draft. The original forest vegetation review image was recovered; absence from evidence.json was not absence of an old asset.

userFeedback.quote: theold ones are better as they are the correct pixel size/density to match the world they live in .the new one would look bad..
userFeedback.decision: Keep existing forest and swamp lily pads. Reject the standalone draft because its pixel size/density does not match the world.
userFeedback.acceptanceRule: Match effective in-world pixel density and intended world footprint using the actual existing runtime asset and neighboring scenery. Canvas dimensions alone do not establish matching density. Show a matched in-world before/after at native gameplay scale plus nearest-neighbor enlargement; do not judge only isolated enlarged sprites.
userFeedback.integration: No replacement authorized. Existing game artwork remains unchanged.
